items.title: Cowboys Push Win Streak to Three with 28-14 Victory over Air Force
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyoming (10/23/26) – The moment was there for the University of Wyoming football team Friday night at War Memorial Stadium. It was one set under the lights, donning special Cowboys and Coal uniforms and against an Air Force team they were tied with for second place in the Mountain West Conference standings.

items.title: Opinion: Wyoming Lucked out by Being Left out of the Pac-12
items.summary: Following the 2023 NCAA football season, a phenomenon known as “conference realignment” shook up the game of football as we know it. One of the “power” conferences within college football, the PAC-12, dispersed all but two of its teams into other conferences, completely changing the dynamic of the game.

items.title: Hughes Named Old Trapper Mountain West Offensive Player of the Week
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyo. (Oct. 19, 2026) – University of Wyoming quarterback Tyler Hughes was named the Old Trapper Mountain West Offensive Player of the Week on Monday. It marks back-to-back weeks that a Cowboy player has earned a weekly Mountain West honor, as kicker Erik Sandvik earned Special Teams Player of the Week honors last week.
